kose01.title: Their "ok." had a period
kose01.caption: A single period sent Virgo's brain into a full simulation: mad, bored, moving to the moon. It was just how they type. Who in your life texts with terrifying punctuation?

kose02.title: Seen at 9:41
kose02.caption: Seen at 9:41, and by 9:58 Cancer was knitting a scarf for the memory. The real reason for the silence? Pasta. What's the longest you've stared at a "Seen"?

kose03.title: One heart, not two
kose03.caption: Two hearts every night, then one. Libra drafted three replies, deleted all of them, and it was a slipped thumb. Be honest: do you count the hearts?

kose04.title: "Can we talk later?"
kose04.caption: Four words, one houseplant jury and a fully rehearsed defence. The big talk was about movie snacks. Which sign spirals hardest at "can we talk?"

kose05.title: Typing... stopped
kose05.caption: Nine minutes of dots appearing and vanishing. A poem? A confession? A whole novel? It was "hi". Tag the friend who types for nine minutes and sends one word.

kose06.title: They wrote "haha"
kose06.caption: Leo told a duck joke and got a lowercase "haha". Three rewrites later, the best friend leaked that it was SO funny. Does a short haha count? Asking for Leo.

kose07.title: The goodbye wave
kose07.caption: Four camera angles, slow motion and a referee review of one goodbye wave. Verdict: fine. Better than fine, actually. Which sign replays every goodbye?

kose08.title: Liked an old photo
kose08.caption: Sagittarius liked a photo from three years ago and started planning life as a lighthouse keeper. They just said hi back. Have you ever done the deep-scroll like?

kose09.title: "hey." not "hey you"
kose09.caption: Last week it was "hey you". Today it was "hey." with a period. Aquarius ran a full lab analysis. They were typing on the bus. Who notices every missing word?
